blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. Taxes can sound hard, but in English they follow simple patterns.

In this lesson, you learn the words that appear on Czarnikow's forms and reports. Today you learn five useful words and practise them in short, natural sentences: question, help, answer, advice and explanation.

Sophie explains the tax words slowly, in simple English. Go step by step. One small step at a time — taxes become easier with practice. You can do it!

items.q: How many new words does the lesson teach today?
items.why: "Today you learn five useful words" — cinco palavras.

items.q: Who explains the tax words?
items.why: "Sophie explains the tax words slowly."

items.q: How does Sophie explain the words?
items.why: "Sophie explains the tax words slowly, in simple English."

items.q: The phrase "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts" suggests that the author wants you to…
options: feel confident that you can do it
items.why: Inferência: a frase e "You can do it!" passam confiança, não medo.

items.q: "One small step at a time" suggests that the author would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: trying to learn everything at once
items.why: Inferência: o texto defende passos pequenos, então discordaria de aprender tudo de uma vez.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie ajudando o aluno a falar com o contador. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! I'm Sophie. Today we talk to the accountant, and we use one small phrase: "Can I…?" It is polite and easy.

When you need something, start with "Can I". For example: "Can I ask a question?" or "Can I have some help with this form?" The accountant will say yes.

Sometimes you want an answer, so you say: "Can I get the answer today?" And when the tax is hard, you can ask: "Can I have some advice?" or "Can I have an explanation, please?"

Remember these five words: question, help, answer, advice, explanation. They are on the forms and reports every week.

Speak slowly. Use short sentences. One small step at a time, and taxes become easier. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What phrase does Sophie teach in this audio?
items.why: "we use one small phrase: 'Can I…?'"

items.q: Why does Sophie like the phrase "Can I…?"
items.why: "It is polite and easy."

items.q: Which sentence does Sophie use as an example?
items.why: "For example: 'Can I ask a question?'"

items.q: Sophie says the five words are on the forms every week. This suggests that…
options: the words are not useful at work
you will really use these words at Czarnikow
the words are only for exams
items.why: Inferência: se aparecem toda semana nos formulários, são úteis no trabalho real.

items.q: How would you best describe Sophie's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela pede calma, frases curtas e diz "You can do it!" — tom acolhedor.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Can I ask a question about this form?" A question is…
items.why: Question = pergunta: algo que você pergunta.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Can I have some ___ with this tax form, please?"
items.why: Help = ajuda; "Can I have some help" pede ajuda.

items.q: "The answer is ready for the accountant to review." An answer is…
items.why: Answer = resposta: o que você responde a uma pergunta.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The tax is hard, so I ask Sophie for ___."
items.why: Advice = conselho; pedimos conselho quando algo é difícil.

items.q: "The explanation stays in the fiscal folder." An explanation is…
items.why: Explanation = explicação: palavras que deixam algo claro.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho com o contador. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can I fill out this tax form?" To fill out a form means to…
items.why: Fill out = preencher: escrever as informações no formulário.

items.q: "I will follow up with the accountant tomorrow." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar continuidade, checar de novo mais tarde.

items.q: "Can I check with Sophie first?" To check with someone means to…
items.why: Check with = confirmar com alguém antes de fazer algo.

items.q: "The accountant has to sign off on the report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval final.

items.q: "Please hand in the form before the deadline." To hand in means to…
items.why: Hand in = entregar, submeter o documento.
